description: Pre-computed, programmatically-verified count of rows where offence_type == "Theft" and fir_date falls in 2025-06 (June 2025). All other rows in this fixture use fir_date years outside 2025 (2023/2024/2026 only), so this combination cannot be matched by any row other than the deliberately-controlled set. Used by the qa-api slice's whole-dataset-vs-sample integration gate test.
